opening.argument: The speaker presents BitConnect as an investment opportunity and directs viewers to sign up, saying it "only costs $100." He recommends putting "$100-$115 dollars in" and describes letting the funds compound daily, with an estimated average of "1.25% daily." He also explains that BitConnect pays a daily percentage with compounded interest, framing cryptocurrency purchase and transfer as the path into that return arrangement. The signup link is disclosed as an affiliate link, and he says he believes he received about $10 in his lending wallet, connecting the promotion to a benefit for himself. His warnings about life savings, millionaire expectations, Bitcoin uncertainty, and the opportunity not lasting forever qualify the pitch but do not retract its signup, investment, and return claims.
